heroDesc: A curated suite of interactive web apps designed for cardiology residents, clinicians, and educators.
sectionTitle: Everything you need, in your browser
aboutTitle: Kardiologi.vercel.app - Built by a doctor for everyone
aboutDesc: This application was created in the midst of busy work as a father, ER & ICU doctor, and other duties in the hospital along with the cardiology residency selection. When studying, I often need clear visualization so that I can connect the existing dots so that a common thread can be drawn. Therefore, I developed this application to solve clinical problems and as an interactive educational tool. The data included is evidence-based and continues to develop with input from the team and users. Greetings, KFMD — Khariz Fahrurrozi
footerDesc: Interactive cardiology web applications built for clinical education and practice. New tools added regularly.
footerCopy: © 2026 Kardiologi by KFMD. For educational purpose only, make the clinical decisions yourself!.

wiggers.title: Interactive Wiggers Diagram
wiggers.desc: Explore the full cardiac cycle with an animated, interactive Wiggers diagram. Hover over phases to understand valve events, pressure curves, and common abnormalities.

ecgaxis.title: ECG Axis Trainer
ecgaxis.desc: Train your eye on ECG axis deviation. Randomized ECG strips with instant feedback — perfect for residents preparing for board exams or daily ward practice.

vessels.title: Blood Vessles Simulator
vessels.desc: Understand the anatomy and physiological function of each blood vessel in the human body from the aorta to the venules and their respective functions.

cvguidelines.title: ESC Recommendation Summary
cvguidelines.desc: Don't have time to read the many ESC guidelines? This application has summarized everything! Literally from 2022-2026.

nodalblock.title: AV Block Simulator
nodalblock.desc: Why should patients with high degree AV Block not be given atropine? If you don't know yet, click this application.
